method: Decoded frames only; no playback and no audio. I read PLAYBOOK §4-§8, DIRECTION (all of it), TRANSCRIPT P08-P15, ledger rows C08-C14 (grep), and fixes S4/S5/S6_v1.json plus range_S4-S6_v1.md. I extracted 5074-9965 from out/ep06/v2/ep06_film.mp4 by decoded index (4,892 frames, count verified) into out/ep06/review/v2/S4-S6/clip_5074_9965.mp4. tools/static_check.py --offset 5074 reports 0 frozen stretches at both the 0.35 and 1.0 thresholds, and 0 empty frames. I used 13 images in all. From tools/sheet.py: overview sheets for S4, S5 and S6 every 30 f (52/59/52 frames, width 320); three native 960 px detail sheets of 8 text-heavy frames each; word-sync sheets for S4 and S6 (48 frames each, at the word frames ±3) and a 48-frame S5 beats sheet (match cut, flip, hero/dive, refusal, sweep, boundary, TRIM); a boundary sheet (5098-5108, 6642-6656, 8396-8410 and 9922-9950, every 2 f). From my own crops of half-scale frames: a race/tray/sweep/split/QuestionCard/flip crop sheet, a 2× crop comparing the f8710 HDD and SSD panels (steel against graphite, confirmed), and a tray strip (f5670, 5690, 6560, 9040). Measurements without images: cap heights from connected components of bright pixels on half-scale frames (about 30 text elements); onset and exit series from bright-pixel fractions in label boxes across the frame-indexed gray decode (Recovery, quote strip, verdict, chips, 'Still full', 'For drives', QuestionCard, Unlisted, Gone, 'At most', 'Distinctive header'); amber, cyan and coral pixel fractions in the SSD panel for the erase timing (8714-8746); per-band luma mean and std (split bottom band, drive-row stage); frame-to-frame motion over 9070-9130; Bit colour in tagged boxes; and the scanner-prop extents at the frame edge. No full-res stills were rendered, because every must-read element measured above the half-scale floors (caps ≥14 px, keywords ≥22 px). I can't verify determinism from frames. The Archive's box ids, states and framings match across S3→S4→S5→S6→S7. Range score = section scores weighted by length (1545/1755/1531 f).
